subject.title: feat(dashboard): widget capabilities — net CSP, host tools, hardened shared sandbox

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this operator-granted dashboard-widget capability model as a supported core security and Gateway-protocol surface?
rationale: The PR deliberately expands the authority available to agent-authored HTML widgets and adds persisted grants plus public RPCs; code review alone cannot choose the acceptable long-term capability and upgrade contract.

options.title: Sponsor with proof and refresh
options.body: Approve the capability direction after a rebase, owner review of the stored/protocol contract, and redacted browser proof of both allowed and denied capability paths.

options.title: Keep dashboard widgets display-only
options.body: Defer network and host-tool authority until the project has a separately approved capability model and compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with proof and refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the capability direction after a rebase, owner review of the stored/protocol contract, and redacted browser proof of both allowed and denied capability paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history places steipete closest to the proposed dashboard capability model, though final ownership should include the relevant security and Gateway reviewers.
